findings.message: devolverComMotivo has a typed reason (details.motivoDevolucao) but the definition declares no <command>.input state. Added the public state devolverComMotivoDraft (DevolverComMotivoDraft) with setDevolverComMotivoDraft; the draft is emptied after success. The id and version come from the method arguments.

The four commands return only resumo and esperaPorMim, which replace those states. avisoDoDia is not returned, so its quantities can lag behind until carregarInicio is called again. pageStatus is written only by the initial load, so it does not become 'empty' after a command empties every list.
public devolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setDevolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
